title: Install Refugi
subtitle: Your safe space, always with you. Quick access from any device.

benefits.title: Benefits of installing
benefits.quickAccessDesc: Open from your desktop or home screen
benefits.notificationsDesc: Get important alerts in real time
benefits.updatesDesc: You'll always have the latest version

instructions.title: Installation instructions
instructions.subtitle: Select your device to see specific instructions

chrome.step1: Click the install icon (⊕) in the address bar
chrome.step4: The app will open automatically and appear on your desktop

safari.note: Safari on macOS has limited PWA support. We recommend using Chrome or Edge for the best experience.

firefox.note: Firefox doesn't support PWA installation on desktop. We recommend using Chrome, Edge, or Brave.

generic.title: Browser not detected
generic.description: To install the app, we recommend using Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Brave. Download one of these browsers and return to this page.

ios.step1: Open this page in Safari (not Chrome)
ios.step2: Tap the share button (□↑) at the bottom
ios.step3: Scroll and select "Add to Home Screen"
ios.step4: Tap "Add" in the top right corner
ios.step5: The app will appear on your home screen
ios.tip: Important: On iOS, only Safari allows installing web apps. If using Chrome, copy this link and open it in Safari.

android.step1: Tap the install button at the top
android.step4: The app will be added to your home screen automatically

firefox.note: Firefox on Android has limited support. We recommend using Chrome or Edge to install the app.

share.title: Share with your team
share.subtitle: Send this link to your employees to install the app
